description: This circular walk from Marlborough takes you into the nearby Savernake Forest. You'll follow the Grey Ride through the forest where you can see some truly impressive old trees including some superb oaks. The walk starts in the centre of the town next to the River Kennet and heads south east into the expansive forest. You'll then follow the circular trail along Grey Ride and Long Harry with lots of woodland wildlife to see on the way.
